top_signals.title: Gold Declines as Hormuz Impasse Keeps Rate-Hike Bets Elevated
top_signals.summary: Gold dropped — following a weekly decline — as an impasse over the Strait of Hormuz kept energy costs elevated and maintained pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates further to combat sticky inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Oil, AI Demand Give Ringgit Room to Rally, Strategists Say
top_signals.summary: The Malaysian ringgit may be poised for gains as higher oil prices and the artificial-intelligence boom provide tailwinds for the currency, strategists say.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
